verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source orchestration tool with a CLI and webserver, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The cited items cover assets, schedules, integrations, the CLI and the MCP server, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
